slides.headline: Mary and Joseph lost their son. After three days, they *find* him.
Mary pulls him close. Three days of fear *melt* away.
Her hand grips his arm. She won't lose him *again*.
But Jesus looks past her, calm and *distant*.
Look at his hands. He is tying his *belt*, ready to leave.
Behind them, Joseph leans in, worn out with *relief*.
The old scholars still hold their scrolls, *stunned* by a boy.
Outside, a builder shapes a *stone* for the Temple.
Hunt went to Jerusalem to paint it. It took six *years*.
It sold for one of the highest prices for a living *artist*.
He barely looks at her. Would you be *angry*, or hold him?
